title: Follow changes to a file in real-time
summary: Watch a file for new content as it is written. This is useful for monitoring log files. Press Ctrl+C to stop watching.

steps.explain: Display the last lines of the file and keep reading it as new lines are added. Press Ctrl+C to stop.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file to monitor

alternatives.explain: Keep reading the file even if it is rotated or temporarily inaccessible (useful for some log systems).
